breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect statement from the incomplete prompt: 'At the outer surface where the bending normal stress is maximum, the torsional shear stress vanishes, so the principal stresses are governed by bending alone.' The ground truth resolves this by removing this erroneous claim entirely, since torsional shear stress is actually maximum at the outer surface of a solid circular shaft. While the rest of the specification correctly includes τxy = τ (from torsion) in the plane stress analysis, the explicit incorrect statement at the end was not removed and directly contradicts the ground truth.
